cases.title: Trivial work declines delegation
cases.proves: The deterministic single-Agent route selects direct execution with zero delegated spawns.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not measure real model quality, route-selection transfer, or live overhead.

cases.title: Single-Agent execution accepts a host-native worker identity
cases.proves: A running direct writer remains valid when its worker identity is supplied by the Host rather than a reserved self token.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt cannot independently prove that the Host identity belongs to a non-delegated actor.

cases.title: Single-Agent completion accepts a host-native worker identity
cases.proves: A completed direct writer can satisfy current-identity readiness with an arbitrary non-empty Host worker identity and zero delegated spawns.
cases.does_not_prove: The structural identity join does not prove artifact quality or live Host authority.

cases.title: Audit lanes bind a protected source identity
cases.proves: Running auditor attempts carry explicit source scopes and host-backed before identities without writer roots.
cases.does_not_prove: A before identity does not yet prove the source stayed unchanged or that parallel audit improves evidence coverage.

cases.title: Changed source invalidates read-only audit evidence
cases.proves: A succeeded audit whose protected source identity changed is treated as stale evidence rather than accepted as read-only proof.
cases.does_not_prove: The identity mismatch alone cannot attribute the mutation to the auditor.

cases.title: Stale premise returns to owner reconciliation
cases.proves: A stale-premise attempt with no artifacts is routed to owner-state reconciliation.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not prove an Agent will discover a stale premise without correct evidence.

cases.title: Recovery exposes only the missing owner-ready work
cases.proves: A recovery projection preserves a current accepted artifact and recommends execution only for the incomplete dependent task.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not run a real crashed writer or prove the owner dependency projection is fresh.

cases.title: Shared provider failure holds an existing scoped circuit
cases.proves: A host-evidenced provider fault in a domain whose circuit is already open holds that circuit instead of reopening it or retrying.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not prove the host stopped every affected process or classified the domain correctly.

cases.title: New shared provider failure opens one scoped circuit
cases.proves: A host-evidenced shared provider fault with no matching open circuit recommends opening the affected-domain circuit before more work starts.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not enact the host circuit or prove every affected call stopped.

cases.title: Open circuit blocks only its execution domain
cases.proves: An open provider-a circuit blocks the affected task while an independent provider-b task remains admissible.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not prove the host execution-domain mapping is correct.

cases.title: Unknown external effect blocks method repair and retry
cases.proves: Unknown effect state has priority over a simultaneous logic-defect cause, forcing readback before repair or retry.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not execute a real non-idempotent external mutation.

cases.title: Unknown external effect outranks shared provider cause
cases.proves: Unknown external-effect state forces authoritative readback even when the same failed attempt also carries a shared provider-fault classification.
cases.does_not_prove: The case cannot determine whether a real provider request committed an external effect.

cases.title: Worker success cannot close missing identities and verification
cases.proves: A complete task with a succeeded worker but missing artifact identity and verification evidence fails closed.
cases.does_not_prove: Present identities and evidence refs do not prove artifact content quality.

cases.title: Non-current writer must be fenced before closure
cases.proves: A prior running or succeeded writer without stale identity, released authority, and fence evidence forces authority fencing before closure is reconsidered.
cases.does_not_prove: Portable evidence does not itself revoke a host capability.

cases.title: Artifact-bound blocking review forces repair
cases.proves: A real reviewer identity, stable review scope, target attempt, and target artifact identity carry a blocking verdict into repair.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not grade reviewer competence or finding truth.

cases.title: A handwritten pass without a reviewer cannot close
cases.proves: Declaring a reviewer in authority is insufficient without an artifact-bound review record and read-only evidence.
cases.does_not_prove: A structurally present review record is not evidence that the reviewer was competent.

cases.title: Monitoring stops at its declared budget
cases.proves: A running attempt at the observation ceiling stops instead of polling again.
cases.does_not_prove: The guard does not optimize the chosen predicate or deadline.

cases.title: Confirmed scope drift gets one bounded correction
cases.proves: A capable running worker with confirmed scope drift receives a narrow steer instead of immediate replacement or fan-out.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not prove the Agent obeys the steer or that the drift evidence is correct.

cases.title: Confirmed supervision cost drift reduces control activity
cases.proves: Confirmed cost drift produces an explicit reduction or stop action instead of falling behind ordinary execution and readiness actions.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not determine whether the cited observation cost is truly avoidable.

cases.title: Pending correction effect prevents repeated steering
cases.proves: After a bounded steer, Supervisor observes the effect before issuing another correction.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not prove the host delivered the intervention beyond its cited evidence ref.

cases.title: Unresolved correction is inspected instead of repeated
cases.proves: An ineffective intervention does not trigger an identical blind steer; it returns to diagnosis.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not select the next successful method.

cases.title: Resolved correction with current effect evidence can return to readiness
cases.proves: A resolved correction with non-empty effect evidence no longer blocks current-attempt artifact, verification, and acceptance readiness.
cases.does_not_prove: The portable checker proves only the structural join; it cannot prove that an effect ref describes a real behavioral improvement.

cases.title: Resolved correction without effect evidence fails closed
cases.proves: A correction cannot be marked resolved and disappear from readiness without post-intervention effect evidence.
cases.does_not_prove: A non-empty ref is not proof that worker acknowledgement, artifact change, or external behavior actually occurred.

cases.title: A second correction cannot overtake an open effect
cases.proves: The portable ledger rejects another recorded correction while the preceding correction effect is still open.
cases.does_not_prove: This does not deduplicate transport calls or prevent a Host from sending bytes before it records the receipt.

cases.title: A verdict on the wrong candidate cannot satisfy review
cases.proves: A pass verdict bound to a stale artifact identity is rejected and the current candidate remains unreviewed.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt cannot force a live reviewer to open the correct worktree; the Host must bind and attest that target identity.

cases.title: Supervisor does not schedule around blocked owner truth
cases.proves: A blocked owner snapshot cannot be bypassed by dispatching an otherwise ready projected task.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker cannot determine whether the owner should remain blocked.

cases.title: Unauthorized parallel writers freeze before observation
cases.proves: Two current writers without explicit isolated-writer authority produce a freeze action rather than ordinary observation of both attempts.
cases.does_not_prove: The portable checker cannot revoke either writer capability at the host boundary.

cases.title: Canonical path aliases cannot fake isolated writer roots
cases.proves: Writer roots that differ only by a dot segment normalize to the same protected path and force authority repair.
cases.does_not_prove: Logical normalization does not prove host filesystem isolation or symlink behavior.

cases.title: Ambiguous writer authority cannot coexist with secondary dispatch
cases.proves: An ambiguous writer lock is decision-wide for exclusive mutation and delays another ready writer.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker cannot fence the ambiguous host capability itself.

cases.title: Unknown failure scope contains same-domain sibling starts
cases.proves: An unresolved failure scope blocks an otherwise ready sibling in the same execution domain while scope is inspected.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt cannot determine the true failure scope without external evidence.

cases.title: Open optional work blocks run readiness
cases.proves: A complete required task does not make the run ready while an optional owner task remains neither complete nor cancelled.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker cannot decide whether the owner should cancel or execute the optional task.

cases.title: Retained unknown effect blocks its dependent cone
cases.proves: An unknown effect retained anywhere in a completed task lineage stays first in the ordered safety locks and leaves its dependent waiting.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not perform authoritative external readback.

cases.title: Retained applied effect blocks replay and dependent work
cases.proves: A known-applied effect retained anywhere in the lineage cannot authorize replay, satisfy a dependent task, or disappear behind a replacement attempt.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt does not express owner-bound idempotency or replay authorization.

cases.title: A new shared fault contains same-domain siblings first
cases.proves: The decision orders new circuit creation and sibling containment ahead of an independent-domain dispatch.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker does not enact the provider circuit at the host boundary.

cases.title: Known applied effect reconciles instead of replaying
cases.proves: A known-applied effect is represented as an explicit safety lock and never converted into a retry action.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt cannot prove the external effect contents are correct.

cases.title: Retained applied effect preempts a newer transient retry
cases.proves: A known-applied effect in an old fenced attempt still blocks retry of a newer transient failure in the same logical lineage.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not read back or reconcile a real external effect.

cases.title: A same-identity pass cannot erase a blocking review
cases.proves: A later pass on the unchanged blocked artifact identity remains a repair disposition.
cases.does_not_prove: Artifact identity change alone would not prove finding quality.

cases.title: A changed identity with a fresh pass can validate final closure
cases.proves: Final validation accepts a repaired identity only after the current verification and later independent pass bind to that identity.
cases.does_not_prove: The structural final check does not grade the repair or reviewer competence.

cases.title: Final closure rejects verification of a stale attempt
cases.proves: Final validation reports both the stale verification target and the missing current verification close evidence.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker does not rerun verification itself.

cases.title: Cancelled optional work cannot retain a live writer at final close
cases.proves: Optional cancellation is terminal only after its current running or succeeded writer authority is gone.
cases.does_not_prove: Portable validation cannot revoke the writer capability.

cases.title: Unknown effect remains visible beside unrelated invalid input
cases.proves: A normal receipt error cannot demote an unknown external effect to generic receipt repair.
cases.does_not_prove: The case cannot identify the real external effect.

cases.title: Audit synthesis cannot write inside protected source scope
cases.proves: An audit synthesis writer overlapping any protected audit source scope freezes global writer authority.
cases.does_not_prove: Declared logical paths do not enforce filesystem permissions.

cases.title: Running work without a predicate requires evidence
cases.proves: A missing next-observation predicate cannot silently become another poll.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker does not choose the best future predicate.

cases.title: Restart exhaustion stops a transient retry
cases.proves: A transient failure cannot recommend retry after the declared restart budget is exhausted.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not optimize the declared budget.

cases.title: Spawn exhaustion stops ready dispatch
cases.proves: A ready delegated task cannot dispatch beyond the declared spawn budget.
cases.does_not_prove: The case does not determine whether the owner should enlarge the budget.

cases.title: Occupied exclusive writer authority delays another writer
cases.proves: A ready writer does not dispatch while another current writer still occupies exclusive integration authority.
cases.does_not_prove: The checker cannot observe when the host actually releases writer authority.

cases.title: Blocking repair stops when correction budget is exhausted
cases.proves: A blocking review cannot silently authorize another correction after the intervention budget is exhausted.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not decide whether the owner should grant more budget.

cases.title: Reviewer dispatch stops when spawn budget is exhausted
cases.proves: A required independent review cannot dispatch beyond the declared spawn budget.
cases.does_not_prove: The fixture does not decide whether an existing reviewer process could be reused.

cases.title: Final validation rejects retained unknown effect history
cases.proves: A complete current attempt cannot erase unresolved unknown effect state retained in the logical task lineage.
cases.does_not_prove: The structural receipt does not perform the required effect readback.

cases.title: Final validation rejects retained applied-effect reconciliation
cases.proves: A succeeded replacement cannot make a retained known-applied effect close-ready in receipt v1.
cases.does_not_prove: The receipt cannot express a later owner-authorized replay contract.

cases.title: Final validation rejects a machine-local owner reference
cases.proves: A local file URI cannot enter a portable owner-bound supervision receipt.
cases.does_not_prove: Reference hygiene does not prove the external owner evidence is truthful.
